{{DISPLAYTITLE:List of Japanese language ''Diamond & Pearl'' home video releases}} {{incomplete}} The following is a list of all of the Japanese language home video releases of ''[[Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl|Pocket Monsters Diamond & Pearl]]''. ==Volume releases== ''[[Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl|Pocket Monsters Diamond & Pearl]]'' was divided into four sets that were released by {{wp|Media Factory}} and [[Shogakukan]] from 2007 to 2011. It contains almost all the [[List of Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl episodes|191 episodes]] between them, except ''[[DP048|Satoshi and Hikari! Facing a New Adventure!!]]'' (a [[clip show]] summarizing the series' first year) and selected episodes that were [[#Special releases|released separately]]. All the DVDs were released for rental only. ===Pocket Monsters Diamond & Pearl=== Pocket Monsters Diamond & Pearl was released by {{wp|Media Factory}} and [[Shogakukan]] starting in 2007. It consists of 19 volumes with 56 episodes across them combined. ''[[DP021|The Strongest Koiking and the Most Beautiful Hinbass!]]'' and ''[[DP057|Beadaru Knew!]]'' were [[#Special releases|released separately]]. The former is included on a DVD along with the [[Pikachu short]] ''[[PK17|Pikachu's Naughty Island]]'', and the latter is included on a DVD along with ''[[PK18|Pikachu's Exploration Club]]''. The first ''[[Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl|Pocket Monsters Diamond & Pearl]]'' [[clip show]], ''[[DP048|Satoshi and Hikari! Facing a New Adventure!!]]'', was not released on DVD. {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{colorschemelight|Sinnoh}}; border: 3px solid #{{colorschemedark|Sinnoh}}; {{roundy|10px}};" !
